content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AMU Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online at https://careers.amuonline.ac.in. Take the printout of the PDF file of the Application Form on A4 Size paper. Append signature and paste recent photograph. Attach attested copies of all relevant documents. Submit the Application Form to the Office of the Principal, University Polytechnic (Boys). Send it on or before 20 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 20 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Assistant Professor (Contractual).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 20 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: All Candidates: Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per UGC norms.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: B.E. / B.Tech. and M.E. / M.Tech. in relevant branch with First Class or Equivalent.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for AMU Recruitment 2026 besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian Nationals (including Overseas Citizens of India Cardholders) may apply. Candidates must belong to E-Category of PwD with relevant disability to a minimum extent of 40%.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates whose self-attested copies of required documents are not enclosed. Late applications received after 20-10-2026 up to 4:00 pm.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Short-listing of applicants. Interview. Interview will be held on 29.10.2026 at 10:00 am at Dean's Office, F/o Engg. & Tech.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Appointment is purely on temporary basis liable to termination at any time without notice.
